chunks: And whatever is in it from ʿAbdullāh ibn Muḥammad al-Juʿfī, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbdullāh, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-Khaṭṭāb, from Jaʿfar ibn Bashīr, from ʿAbdullāh ibn Muḥammad al-Juʿfī.

key_terms.أَبِي: My father; the immediate transmitter from whom the author reports.
key_terms.جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ: A transmitter in the sanad/isnad leading to the named narrator.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I narrated it; indicates direct authorial transmission of the report.
key_terms.سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: A transmitter in the sanad/isnad of this report.
key_terms.عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْجُعْفِي: A narrator whose transmission path is being identified here.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAbdullāh ibn Muḥammad al-Juʿfī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad for reports transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn Muḥammad al-Juʿfī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission through which the author received these hadith.
